Hymn 63: Great King of Heaven
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: A. Laurence Lyon
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 63 titled "Great King of Heaven" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by A. Laurence Lyon and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
